# arttime notices

The accompanying LICENSE_ART and LICENSE_ADDENDUM_CFLA are unmodified upstream license notices retrieved on 2026-10-20 from [poetaman/arttime](https://github.com/poetaman/arttime). The upstream `main` revision observed during retrieval was `38c2955a7c16d6900cc121265595347266b18af8`.

These notices describe upstream rights; they do not change the MIT terms for Arcana's original code or transfer ownership of any pictured illustration. arttime is maintained by Aman Mehra, and the art itself belongs to individual artists. Arcana is independent.

No upstream source code or deck files are bundled. Selected tarot illustrations are visible in the README's noncommercial demonstration screenshots. The screenshots were provided by the project owner and show artwork from their local installation; its exact upstream revision has not been established. The images retain original in-art markings; the exact individual artist behind those markings has not been independently verified.
